title: Dirty Water Mosquito Scanner
problem: Dirty water stands near our street pump for days, and soon everyone in the lane starts getting sick with high fever and chills.
idea: A water scanner. The camera looks at water near our homes and says if mosquitoes can breed there, then asks people to clean the drain. Here you can tap the water the camera 'sees'.

widgets.heading: 🎯 Try it: What water does the camera see?
widgets.intro: In my real project, Teachable Machine learns photos of clean and stagnant water. Here, tap one.
widgets.question: The camera sees:

options.label: Green still water near pump
options.result: ALERT! Mosquitoes can breed here. Please clean the drain and let the water flow.
options.te: హెచ్చరిక! ఇక్కడ దోమలు పెరుగుతాయి. కాలువ శుభ్రం చేయండి.

options.label: Rainwater in old tyre or pot
options.result: ALERT! Empty this water and turn it upside down.

options.label: Uncovered water drum
options.result: Careful! Cover the drum with a lid or cloth.

options.label: Clean flowing water
options.result: Good! Flowing water is not a mosquito home.

widgets.heading: ✅ Our Street's Friday Dry Day
widgets.intro: Tick what your family did this week to stop mosquitoes.

items.text: Emptied and dried water pots, coolers and buckets
items.te: కుండలు, కూలర్లు, బకెట్లు ఖాళీ చేసి ఆరబెట్టాము

items.text: Threw away old tyres, coconut shells, broken pots
items.te: పాత టైర్లు, కొబ్బరి చిప్పలు, పగిలిన కుండలు తీసేశాము

items.text: Cleared the drain near our house
Anyone with high fever went to the PHC

bands.text: Good! Finish the rest before Friday.
Mosquitoes love your street now. Start today!

how: Take photos (from a safe distance) of clean water and of green, stagnant water around the village.
Open Teachable Machine, choose Image Project, and make 2 classes: Clean water and Stagnant water.
Upload about 50 photos for each, click Train, and Export the model.
In Scratch, load the model. When it sees stagnant water, play an alert and show 'Please clean the drain!'.
Ask Gemini to write a short Telugu message for neighbours about dry day.
Show the scanner at a Gram Sabha or school assembly.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student. Write a short, friendly message in simple Telugu and English asking my neighbours to clean the stagnant water near our street pump to stop mosquitoes. Add 5 easy dry-day tips.
